name: Per-Field Max Pyramid in Deviation Space
definition: A max-value pyramid stored in deviation space (normalized distance from contrast center) used for TF-adaptive skipping. It is built from the raw volume cube, not the display mips, to avoid hiding thin bright filaments.
summary: A max-value pyramid in deviation space built from raw volume data to enable transfer-function-adaptive skipping, avoiding the thin filament loss caused by standard box-filtered mipmaps.
